1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `displayName` string property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.
2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added one `@Mapping(target = "displayName", expression = "java(owner.getLastName() + \", \" + owner.getFirstName())")` annotation to the existing `toOwnerDto` abstract method.

This keeps structural impact minimal: I avoided adding a method to the large `Owner` model class (high WMC_other) and avoided touching any of the endpoint pipeline function classes. MapStruct emits the concatenation directly in generated code, so no new function bodies were introduced. `AcceptanceTest.coreComputesDisplayName` and the full suite pass.
